sources.title: VCG Firm Credentials 2026
sources.text: Vertex Consulting Group is a mid-sized management consulting firm with 2000 consultants across six practices: Strategy, Operations, Technology, Supply Chain, Finance and Risk Advisory. VCG operates across 12 markets. The average engagement team size is 7 consultants. VCG has delivered 340 engagements since 2020, with a client repeat-engagement rate of 68 percent.

sources.title: VCG Delivery Methodology Overview
sources.text: VCG follows a four-phase delivery methodology: Diagnose, Design, Deliver, Sustain. Every engagement is governed by a joint steering committee that meets fortnightly. VCG assigns a dedicated Engagement Quality Director, independent of the delivery team, to every engagement running longer than 6 months. Knowledge transfer workshops are run in the final 4 weeks of every engagement.

sources.title: Proposal - Global Operations Review, Halden Group
sources.text: Leveraging our presence in 14 markets, VCG can mobilise local delivery teams within 10 business days of contract signature. The Halden engagement covered 9 operating units and delivered a 12 percent reduction in indirect operating cost over 10 months.

sources.title: Proposal - Distribution Network Redesign, Meridian Industrial
sources.text: VCG redesigned Meridian Industrial's distribution network across 4 regional distribution centres, reducing outbound logistics cost by 14 percent within 11 months. The engagement deployed a 6 person team over 9 months and applied VCG's Network Optimiser toolkit to model 27 scenarios against service-level and cost constraints. Inventory carrying cost fell 9 percent in the same period.

sources.title: Case Study - Supplier Risk Segmentation, Arclight Manufacturing
sources.text: VCG segmented 1180 suppliers into four risk tiers using spend concentration, geographic exposure and financial-health signals. Single-source dependency was reduced from 23 percent to 9 percent of addressable spend over 14 months. A supplier early-warning dashboard was handed over to the client's procurement team at close.

sources.title: Internal - Supply Chain Practice Capability Note
sources.text: The Supply Chain practice has 310 consultants. Deep bench strength in demand planning, network design and S&OP. Thin bench in customs and trade-compliance work - flag to the practice lead before committing to trade-heavy scopes. Two senior network-design leads are committed until Q3.

sources.title: Proposal - Finance Function Transformation, Calder Foods
sources.text: VCG reduced Calder Foods' month-end close from 12 days to 6 days and standardised 41 reporting templates across 3 legal entities. The 8 month engagement introduced a controls-first close calendar and retrained 55 finance staff on the new process.

sources.title: Case Study - Working Capital Release, Voss Retail
sources.text: VCG released 180 Cr of working capital for Voss Retail over 12 months through a coordinated DPO and DSO reset alongside an inventory policy redesign covering 6 categories. Payment terms were renegotiated with 140 suppliers.

sources.title: Proposal - Enterprise Risk Framework, Northbank Financial
sources.text: VCG built a three-lines-of-defence operating model for Northbank Financial, rationalising 62 controls to 38 without loss of coverage. Outstanding regulatory findings were closed within 2 review cycles. The engagement ran 7 months with a 5 person team.

sources.title: Internal - Risk Advisory Delivery Note
sources.text: Risk Advisory practice has 240 consultants. Regulatory remediation work is priced on a fixed-fee basis. Avoid time-and-materials commitments where a regulator-driven deadline is in scope. Escalate any scope touching sanctions screening to the practice lead.

sources.title: Proposal - Application Rationalisation, Kestrel Logistics
sources.text: VCG rationalised Kestrel Logistics' application estate from 214 applications to 96, reducing annual run cost by 19 percent over 18 months. A target architecture and a 3 wave decommissioning plan were delivered in the first 10 weeks.

sources.title: Case Study - Cloud Migration, Denhoff Media
sources.text: VCG migrated 68 workloads to public cloud for Denhoff Media across 7 months with zero unplanned downtime. Infrastructure cost fell 22 percent against the pre-migration baseline and deployment frequency rose from monthly to weekly.

sources.title: Proposal - Operating Model Redesign, Larkfield Group
sources.text: VCG redesigned Larkfield Group's operating model across 5 business units, removing 3 management layers and cutting decision cycle time by 31 percent. The engagement ran 6 months and included a 90 day transition support period.

sources.title: VCG Approved Rate Card FY26
sources.text: Approved FY26 day rates: Partner 145000. Director 98000. Manager 62000. Consultant 38000. Analyst 24000. Rates are exclusive of taxes and expenses. Discounts beyond 10 percent require Partner and Commercial Director sign-off.
